# Optimizer360

> Optimizer360 (optimizer360.ai) is the AI-native organic marketing company. Tagline: "Own your growth." It makes brands found, trusted, followed, talked about and chosen across AI answers, search, media and communities, using its own platform (Optimizer GEO) plus six specialist teams. Home market India; also the United States and Mauritius. Contact: abhay@optimizer360.ai

Key facts: tracks 8 AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, Microsoft Copilot, Google AI Overviews), up to 10,000 prompts per brand per day. Method: Scan, Diagnose, Fix, Prove, measured against each client's Week-1 baseline. In one real-estate programme the visibility score rose from 32% to 58% across eight engines in under 2.5 months. Optimizer360 never names clients and never promises rankings. Works in 10 industries.

## Solutions

- [Six things you should own.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/): Optimizer360 is an organic marketing agency in India that builds six growth assets you own: AI visibility, reviews, media, community, chat agents, pipeline.
  Optimizer360 is an AI-native organic marketing company in India. It builds six assets a brand owns instead of rents: its story in AI answers, its reputation, a feeder network of sites and channels, content and community, AI chat agents and a traced leads pipeline. AI agents and expert teams run all six as one engine, measured every week.
- [Get named in the answer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo/): GEO agency in India. Generative engine optimisation services that get your brand named and cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
  Generative engine optimisation (GEO) is the work of getting a brand named, cited and described accurately in AI answers from engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. A GEO agency measures what those engines say today, finds the sources they trust, fixes the pages, reviews and press behind each answer, then re-measures every week.
- [Accuracy, not spin.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo-investor-relations/): Investor relations GEO for listed companies in India. We keep what AI tells investors accurate and current, using public disclosures only, within SEBI rules.
  Investor relations GEO keeps what AI engines tell investors about a listed company accurate and current. It uses only public disclosures, follows SEBI rules and needs company sign-off before anything is published. The work strengthens the sources AI reads, such as filings, annual reports and call transcripts, and sets drift alerts so each new result replaces the old figures.
- [Be trusted before the call.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/reputation/): Online reputation management in India for the AI era: real reviews, public replies, fact corrections and press that shape your brand reputation in AI answers.
  Online reputation management is the steady work of earning real reviews and real press, replying to every review in public and correcting wrong facts wherever they appear. It now also shapes how AI engines describe a brand, because they read review sites, portals and media before they summarise it. Optimizer360 runs this work with drift alerts and weekly reporting.
- [Build the roads in.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/feeder-network/): Build an owned media network of feeder sites, channels and earned media that sends buyers your way and gives AI engines independent brand mentions to trust.
  A feeder network is the set of channels a brand owns or earns that send buyers, and AI engines, back to it. Owned feeders include a blog, a guide site, a video channel, a newsletter and a WhatsApp channel. Earned feeders include creators, credible "best X in Y" lists and independent newsletters. Together they create the brand mentions that AI engines look for.
- [Get talked about.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/content-community/): Community-led growth for brands: communities you host, Reddit and Quora answers posted openly as the brand, content agents and digital PR that earn real talk.
  Community-led growth means real customers discuss, defend and recommend your brand in places you help keep alive: a community on your own site, Reddit and Quora threads where the brand posts openly under its own name, and the media through digital PR. Content agents draft, people edit and approve, and nothing is posted as a fake customer.
- [Answer every buyer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/ai-agents/): AI chat agents for lead qualification on your website, WhatsApp and Instagram. They answer accurately, qualify buyers and book calls or visits, day and night.
  AI chat agents are assistants on your website, WhatsApp and Instagram that answer buyer questions accurately, qualify each lead and book a call or visit, at any hour. Optimizer360 builds them on the same verified facts used in your GEO work, so the answer in your chat matches the answer buyers saw in an AI engine.
- [Fund what actually works.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/leads-pipeline/): Organic lead generation with attribution for AI search. We trace each deal to the AI answer, review, thread or video where demand began, so you fund what works.
  Organic lead generation brings in buyers through channels you own and earn rather than paid ads. Attribution for AI search traces each deal back to where demand began, such as an AI answer, a review, a forum thread or a video, so budgets follow evidence. Optimizer360 connects first mention to closed deal and reports it every week.
- [See what AI says.](https://optimizer360.ai/platform/): Optimizer GEO is our AI visibility tracking platform. It runs up to 10,000 prompts per brand a day on 8 AI engines, tracking brand mentions, sources and fixes.
  Optimizer GEO is the platform Optimizer360 built to track how brands appear in AI answers. It runs up to 10,000 prompts per brand a day across eight engines, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, recording who is named, in what order and which sources are cited. Our teams use it to plan, ship and prove every fix.

A homebuyer's answer leans on property portals and RERA records, a SaaS buyer's on review sites and docs, a patient's on medical references. Optimizer360 works in nine industries, measures 8 AI engines and fixes the sources each sector's answers depend on.

In one real-estate programme, a residential developer in India moved from a 32% to a 58% visibility score in under 2.5 months. We never name clients and never promise rankings.
- [32% to 58% in AI answers.](https://optimizer360.ai/results/real-estate-ai-visibility/): A residential developer in India went from a 32% to a 58% visibility score across 8 AI engines in under 2.5 months. What we did and how we measured it.

Citation rate, share of voice and brand sentiment all went up, and the developer now shows up for 80–90 tracked buyer questions. The work combined site pages, communities, reference sources, press and video.

## Guides

- [AI search, explained.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/): Plain guides to generative engine optimisation: how AI engines pick sources, GEO vs SEO, Reddit and Wikipedia, and how to measure AI visibility.
  The Optimizer360 blog explains generative engine optimisation (GEO) in plain terms: how AI engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews build answers, which sources they cite, how GEO relates to SEO, how to take part in Reddit and Wikipedia ethically, how to measure AI visibility, and what listed companies should know.
- [GEO, explained plainly.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/what-is-generative-engine-optimisation/): Generative engine optimisation (GEO) explained: how AI engines build answers, the levers that get your brand named and cited, and how to measure it.
  Generative engine optimisation (GEO) is the practice of making a brand accurately named, described and cited in answers from AI engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. It works by publishing clear, citable facts on your own pages and earning consistent mentions in the third-party sources those engines retrieve and trust.
- [SEO still counts. GEO builds on it.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/geo-vs-seo/): GEO vs SEO explained: how ranking pages differs from being named in AI answers, where the two overlap, and why SEO still matters. With a comparison table.
  GEO and SEO aim at different outcomes. SEO earns rankings and clicks from search results; GEO earns accurate mentions and citations inside AI answers from engines such as ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. GEO builds on SEO rather than replacing it, because many AI engines retrieve from search indexes and favour pages that are crawlable, clear and trusted.
- [Who the engines listen to.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/how-ai-engines-choose-sources/): How does ChatGPT choose sources? What studies from Profound, Semrush, Peec AI and Ahrefs show about how AI engines pick the brands they recommend.
  AI engines such as ChatGPT choose sources by retrieving pages relevant to the question and favouring those that answer it directly, come from domains they treat as reliable and agree with other sources. Citation studies show Wikipedia, Reddit, review sites and media carry heavy weight, but the shares differ by engine and shift quickly.
- [Show up openly. Never fake it.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/reddit-wikipedia-ai-visibility/): An ethical playbook for Reddit, Wikipedia and Wikidata: how brands can show up in the sources AI engines cite most, without astroturfing or paid edits.
  Brands can improve AI visibility through Reddit and Wikipedia by taking part openly. On Reddit, post from a named brand account and answer real questions, never astroturf. On Wikipedia, propose corrections on the talk page with reliable sources and a conflict-of-interest disclosure, never promotional edits. On Wikidata, keep one clean, accurate entity for the company.
- [Measure the answer, not the hope.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/measure-ai-visibility/): How to measure AI visibility: visibility score, citation rate, AI share of voice and sentiment, built on a prompt universe, a Week-1 baseline and drift checks.
  To measure AI visibility, build a fixed set of buyer questions (a prompt universe), run it across the AI engines your buyers use and record every answer with its date. Track four numbers against a Week-1 baseline: visibility score, citation rate, share of voice and brand sentiment. Re-run on a schedule to catch drift.
- [Investors ask AI. Is it right?](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/ai-answers-investor-relations/): What does ChatGPT say about your listed company? Why AI answers to investors go stale, and how IR teams can correct them using public disclosures only.
  AI answers about listed companies are assembled from whatever the engine finds: filings, news, old articles, forums and data sites. They can quote outdated figures or lead with a resolved controversy. Investor relations teams can improve accuracy by publishing current, clearly structured disclosures on the IR website and keeping public facts consistent, within SEBI rules.
- [GEO terms, in plain words.](https://optimizer360.ai/glossary/): A plain GEO glossary: 28 terms on generative engine optimisation and AI search, from citation rate and visibility score to llms.txt, E-E-A-T and drift.
  This GEO glossary defines the terms used in generative engine optimisation and AI search: how engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews build answers, how brands get cited in them, and how visibility is measured. Each definition is short and neutral, so you can use it in a brief, a board paper or a conversation with an agency.
- [Questions, answered plainly.](https://optimizer360.ai/faq/): Answers about GEO and Optimizer360: how it differs from SEO, engines we track, timelines, pricing, pilots, compliance, ethics and why we never name clients.
  Optimizer360 is an AI-native organic marketing company that helps brands get named, cited and described accurately in AI answers, search, media and communities. We track 8 AI engines, work in 10 industries, start every programme with a Week-1 baseline and report weekly. We never promise rankings, never name clients and never post fake reviews. The questions below cover the rest.

## Frequently asked

- Q: What does Optimizer360 do?
  A: We make brands found, trusted, followed, talked about and chosen in AI answers, search, media and communities. AI agents track how engines describe you, and our expert teams fix what is missing or wrong, from pages and schema to reviews, PR and community answers.
- Q: What is generative engine optimisation (GEO)?
  A: GEO is the practice of making a brand easier for AI engines to find, trust, name and cite in their answers. The US spelling is generative engine optimization. It covers what you publish, the sources engines rely on and how accurately you are described.
- Q: How is GEO different from SEO?
  A: SEO aims to rank pages in a list of search results. GEO aims to get your brand named, cited and described accurately inside the answer itself. The two share foundations, which is why we report on both scoreboards: the AI answers, and SEO plus owned enquiries.
- Q: Which AI engines do you track?
  A: Eight: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews. We track up to 10,000 prompts per brand a day and store every answer with its date.
- Q: How long does GEO take to show results?
  A: It depends on your category, starting point and the sources engines already trust. In one real-estate programme, a residential developer in India moved from a 32% to a 58% visibility score across 8 engines in under 2.5 months. That is one programme, not a promise.
- Q: How much does GEO cost?
  A: It depends on scope: the brands, markets and questions involved. We do not publish prices. Most clients start with a Week-1 baseline, which gives a scorecard, a ranked question universe and a costed plan.
- Q: Do we have to sign a long contract?
  A: No. There are three ways to start: a baseline and universe map; owning your strongest questions first; or a one-quarter pilot with both scoreboards reported monthly and a clear go or stop at month 3.
- Q: Do you guarantee rankings in ChatGPT or Google?
  A: No. The engines decide what they say, and anyone who guarantees rankings is guessing. We do the work rigorously, measure from a Week-1 baseline and show every week what moved.
- Q: How do you measure and report results?
  A: We take a Week-1 baseline, log every fix with its date and re-measure after it is published and crawled. Weekly reports compare against the baseline on two scoreboards: the AI answers, and SEO plus owned enquiries.
- Q: Do you name your clients or show testimonials?
  A: No. We never name, describe identifiably, count or quote clients, and we show no logos or testimonials. Our case studies describe the sector and the market only.
- Q: Do you post on Reddit or edit Wikipedia for clients?
  A: On Reddit and Quora we post openly as the brand, never through fake accounts. On Wikipedia we only propose factual corrections on talk pages, with sources, and never make promotional edits.
- Q: Do you write fake reviews?
  A: Never. We help brands earn a steady stream of real reviews and reply to every one in public. No fabricated reviews, figures or astroturfing.
- Q: How do you handle compliance in India?
  A: Brand, legal and regulatory sign-off comes before anything goes live. We check against RERA, ASCI and SEBI rules where they apply, and our work is aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP).
- Q: Can you help a listed company with what AI tells investors?
  A: Yes, through our Investor Relations package. We keep AI answers accurate and current using only public disclosures, follow SEBI rules and get company sign-off before anything is published. Accuracy, not spin.
- Q: Are you an agency or a software tool?
  A: We are an agency that runs on our own platform, Optimizer GEO. The platform tracks the engines, answers and sources; our six specialist teams ship the fixes and own the KPIs.
- Q: Which industries do you work in?
  A: Nine: real estate and hospitality; financial services and investor relations; retail and consumer brands; food and FMCG; B2B and professional services; technology and SaaS; pharma and healthcare; manufacturing; industrial and engineering; cinema and entertainment.
- Q: Which countries do you work in?
  A: Our home market is India. We also work in the United States and Mauritius.
- Q: What do we get in the first week?
  A: A Week-1 baseline: a readiness scorecard across 8 factors, a ranked universe of the questions your buyers ask, and a costed plan. It is the line every later result is measured against.
- Q: How do we get started?
  A: Email abhay@optimizer360.ai or request an AI audit on our contact page. It shows which engines name you, who they name instead, the sources they cite and the first fixes we would make.
